name: daylight-field-case
comment: The field case as a two-state object for an interactive transition (Colby 22:45): the CLOSED cell from the site board is the reference and the first frame; this board draws the OPEN state at the same camera with an EMPTY interior, to be the last frame and the UI background.
subject: 16-bit pixel art, hard pixel edges, dithering, no anti-aliasing, exactly the same art style, palette, camera angle, framing, lighting, table, lantern and mug as the reference image of the closed leather field case. No text, no letters, no logos.
negative: text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, blur, anti-aliasing, screens, charts, diagrams, papers, objects inside the case

styles.label: FIELD CASE open, interior completely empty
styles.style: The very same brown leather field case, in the very same position on the same wooden camp table with the same lantern and mug, but now OPEN: the lid hinged up and back so its inside faces the viewer, and the case interior is COMPLETELY EMPTY: a flat plain dark suede lining with nothing in it at all, no paper, no screen, no tools, no compartments. Same camera, same light.

styles.label: FIELD CASE half open (mid-frame guide)
styles.style: The very same brown leather field case, same position, table, lantern and mug, but the lid HALF open at forty-five degrees, a sliver of plain dark empty suede interior visible, nothing inside. Same camera, same light.
